integrity: The quantified theorem is proved by an explicit p-adic difference-quotient argument; independent recurrence enumeration over exponents 1..6 is corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The exact residue census is established for powers of five only. Densities count indices. The least-period formula and general p-adic interpolation/Hensel methods predate this result. Global historical priority and independent audit remain unresolved.
title: The exact five-adic residue frequencies of derangement numbers
